current_evidence: No separate local validation list was found on the council site or by search; the 'Apply for planning permission' page holds per-application-type 'Supporting documents' tables, and planning.data.gov.uk records this same page as Rutland's local area requirements ('Couldn't find any sort of checklist'). The page shows no date.

issues.detail: Grokbot marked the link 'not readable: blocked/404/login' and captured nothing, but the page loads and contains per-application-type supporting document tables that function as Rutland's local requirements.
issues.evidence: Page text: 'All planning applications require supporting documents'

issues.detail: Householder: block plan (always), existing and proposed elevations (always), existing and proposed floor plans (always), Design and Access Statement only where floor area increase is over 100 m2 in a conservation area. Full application: block plan, elevations, floor plans always; D&A Statement for buildings of 100 m2+ floorspace, one or more dwellings in a conservation area, and major applications.
issues.evidence: Supporting documents tables, Householder and Full application sections

issues.detail: Listed building consent: sectional drawings for windows and doors (always, per 'Cross Sections and Drawings Required for Window and Doors' guidance, 2026), Heritage Impact Assessment, D&A Statement depending on complexity, block plan where external works. Discharge of conditions: elevations, floor plans, sectional drawings and D&A as specific to the condition. Larger home extension prior approval and LDC: block plan, elevations, floor plans.
issues.evidence: Supporting documents tables, Listed building / Discharge of conditions / Prior approval / Certificate of lawful development sections

issues.detail: Workbook says the URL came from a third-party directory (planninggeek) and was not verified; it is in fact the council's own page. No list date can be given as the page is undated.

summary: Rutland has no formal local validation list; its requirements live in supporting-document tables on the 'Apply for planning permission' page, which Grokbot linked correctly but wrongly marked unreadable, so all its requirement rows are empty.
